summary: Documentation commit 4b02b9ca5 passes. The PR body's "How to test the behavior?" section now centers on Mikhail's command exactly as recorded in jf-commands.json and run_case.py (-k exp=mfx100848724,run=49 -d jungfrau -o ./work1 --nrecs 50 --nrecs1 50 --stepnum 2), with the serial environment (PS_PARALLEL=none) and unset PS_SMD_N_EVENTS matching run_jf.py's harness environment. The before/after table matches jf-results.json: master 9ab5c193b default -> exit 1, 0 raw events, 0 gate files, UnboundLocalError on 'ievt'; fixed default -> exit 0, 50 events equal to oracle step 2 [:50], 2 gate files of shape 32x512x1024; master with 10000 -> identical gates (exact_equal true). The "effective MFX default 1000" claim is confirmed by psana/psana/datasource.py:118-119. The body distinguishes the protected instrumented measurements (isolated outputs, readonly name lookup, blocked calibration writes) from the proposed direct manual reviewer command and asks the reviewer to confirm the command works. #284 is stated as a separate open follow-up with no closing reference; production SHA 38010bfb1 and the GitHub check results (100 passed, 3 skipped) match publication.json. Local counts (142 core, 4 byhand) match validation.md. One low, non-blocking finding: the harness also stubbed logbook file discovery (_get_file_info_from_db -> {}), which the body's protection list omits.
